 Summary
 WSL leaders Chelsea face Liverpool at St Helen's Stadium

 Bompastor names side without recognised striker - team news 
 Reds won 3-0 at Brighton to snap three-game losing streak

 Get involved Live Reporting
 Alex Brotherton
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 43 mins 43 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 I don't think I've seen the Chelsea defence look this fraught and uncomfortable this season. They are really finding it tough to play through Liverpool's press.
 Katie McCabe will be having nightmares about Vivien Endemann for the next week.
 2 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 40 mins 40 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Chelsea look to land a sucker-punch after surviving a period of Liverpool pressure - Sandy Baltimore runs into space on the left flank but Khiara Keating rushes out and blocks, with the ball coming back off Baltimore and out for a goal-kick.
 7 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 39 mins 39 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Fuka Nagano threads a pass through midfield to Natalia Ramos who turns and shoots from outside the box, but Hannah Hampton parries before gathering at the second attempt.
 7 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 38 mins 38 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Again, Liverpool force a Chelsea turnover - Lexi Potter plays a loose pass 20 yards from her own goal but Vivien Endemann fires over on the stretch.
 6 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:21 GMT 13:21 GMT 
 Use form at top of page 
 Hampton touches the ball more than the forwards....it's repetitive and played out!
 Osei, New Zealand 
 4 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 36 mins 36 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Fuka Nagano spreads the ball to Vivien Endemann on the right but her low cross is well cut out by Veerle Buurman.
 Grace Fisk gets her head to the corner but it goes well over.
 Liverpool are pushing as half-time approaches.
 8 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 33 mins 33 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Natalia Ramos catches the free-kick beautifully but there isn't quite enough dip on it and her curling strike lands on the roof of the net.
 9 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 32 mins 32 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Vivien Endemann gets on the ball in the left channel, drives towards the box, and is felled by Ellie Carpenter.
 Liverpool free-kick in a very promising position.
 8 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 31 mins 31 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 It's another top save from Khiara Keating, who gets fingertips to Sandy Baltimore's drive from the left!
 15 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 30 mins 30 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 It's end-to-end!
 Liverpool attack and a cross from Vivien Endemann on the left is half cleared by Lucy Bronze.
 Fuka Nagano runs onto the loose ball with a snap-shot, and Hannah Hampton almost fumbles it into her own net. 
 Fortunately for Chelsea the sting has been taken out of the shot and Hampton recovers.
 12 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 29 mins 29 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Alyssa Thompson is again played in on goal, but she takes a heavy touch and Jenna Clark takes the opportunity to make a sliding recovery challenge.
 Chelsea are moving up through the gears.
 13 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 28 mins 28 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Alyssa Thompson runs onto a through ball from Sjoeke Nusken and spins away from Grace Fisk, but her shot is brilliantly tipped over the bar by Khiara Keating. 
 Big stop from the Liverpool goalkeeper, who confidently claims the resulting corner.
 12 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 26 mins 26 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Chelsea play a corner short to Katie McCabe who squares to Keira Walsh at the edge of the box, but her first-time strike is blocked and Liverpool clear. S
 he didn't quite catch that as she would have liked.
 5 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 25 mins 25 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Big chance for Liverpool, and it comes from their pressing!
 Vivien Endemann charges down another Katie McCabe clearance, wins the ball and tees up Natalia Ramos.
 The Spaniard's shot is poor and drags wide, but Beata Olsson comes agonisingly close to getting a touch that would surely divert the ball in.
 12 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 23 mins 23 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Sara Agrez is running back towards her goal and is in trouble, but goes down rather easily and wins a free-kick. She's fortunate there; Alyssa Thompson was waiting to pounce.
 5 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:05 GMT 13:05 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Image source, Getty Images Liverpool have won only five of their 26 WSL meetings with Chelsea (four draws and 17 defeats), though each of the most recent four of those have come at home, most recently in May 2024 (4-3).
 They've certainly started well this afternoon.
 12 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19 mins 19 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Liverpool cut through Chelsea on the break far too easily, but Vivien Endemann's low cross into the box is too close to Hannah Hampton.
 12 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17 mins 17 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Lexi Potter looks to drag a low first-time shot into the bottom corner from the edge of the box, but it goes wide.
 Alyssa Thompson was close to getting a toe to that, which might have directed it on target.
 8 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15 mins 15 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 It's a rare mistake from Hannah Hampton on the ball as she goes to field a back pass under pressure from Vivien Endemann, gifting Liverpool a corner.
 Grace Fisk meets the delivery, but Hampton plucks the header out of the air.
 13 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14 mins 14 mins 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Chelsea play through the Liverpool press again and this time Sandy Baltimore is away down the left, but her shot is blocked by Grace Fisk.
 The visitors come again but Ellie Carpenter can't get on a ball across the six-yard line, before Keira Walsh fires over from the edge of the box.
